notes.title: Brand principles
notes.body:
Brand principles

Cove should feel warm, editorial, and quietly luxurious — never corporate.

Do

  • Soft neutrals with one terracotta accent

  • Generous whitespace in hero layouts

Type pairing

Display: Fraunces · UI: Source Sans. Token file is cove-tokens.json.

Don't

  • Harsh black type on pure white

  • Generic stock “handshake” imagery

notes.title: Migration plan
notes.body:
Migration plan

North & Co. WooCommerce → Shopify Plus cutover outline.

Phases

  1. Catalog + redirects dry run

  2. Theme polish + apps

  3. DNS cutover weekend

Freeze window

No catalog edits 48h before go-live. Store theme repo branch is cutover/shopify-plus.
